description.value: Super 8 by Wyndham Salmon Arm is a nationally branded budget hotel situated on the northeast side of Salmon Arm in the Shuswap region of British Columbia. As part of the Wyndham Rewards network, it offers a familiar, consistent lodging option for travellers passing through a community that sits along the Trans-Canada Highway corridor. Touring cyclists riding through the Thompson-Okanagan region will find it a straightforward overnight stop near the commercial centre of town.
